name: read-the-room
description: Help your agent write clear updates, reviews, documentation, and chat messages suited to the reader.

interface.shortDescription: Write clearly for the reader and channel
interface.longDescription: Help your agent adapt its writing to the reader and channel, from session updates and pull requests to issue trackers, documentation, and chat. Preserve facts, uncertainty, and the detail readers need.
defaultPrompt: Rewrite this clearly for the human and channel.
Draft a concise pull or merge request description.
Turn this update into a useful chat message.
